CAMERA. Compose 9:16 with the action in the safe centre band. Use a dolly-out that opens the frame into its environment on a 90mm tilt-shift, framing with deep negative space above the subject with a low horizon.

LOOK AND SOUND. Light with a hard fresnel through an egg-crate grid for a crisp-edged shadow; grade as a Portra-style palette with creamy skin tones and soft greens. Specify the sound design in one clause — what the viewer hears in the first second decides whether they stay.
